title: pg_observer_bootstrap_apply_attestation_v1
description: Trusted-host-signed post-apply attestation that unlocks a production S2.0 observer-bootstrap APPLIED. It binds the exact intent identity, the applied catalog digest, the DISTINCT verifier's reobserved digest (== applied), evidence_class=PLATFORM_ATTESTED, and a trusted-host-signed timestamp; it is signed by the §9.1 trust-root Ed25519 key family under a DISTINCT attestor identity (aiml-s2-observer-bootstrap-attestor-v1) and namespace (arcane-equilibrium-aiml-s2-observer-bootstrap-apply), domain-separated from the pre-approval operator authorization. Only a real trusted host holding the off-repo private key can produce a signature that verifies against the pinned ATTESTOR_PUBLIC_KEY. The offline validator verifies structure + attestation_digest integrity + trust-root binding only; the SSHSIG crypto gate lives at apply time and full runtime authenticity is EFFECT-only.
